product_price. There is NO _meta column on this dict -- do not try to stamp one.
type = brand + ' ' + model_no (533/549 exact; the mismatches are rows whose model_no carries a
load-bearing leading/trailing space, e.g. model_no 'HWD-C500E ' -> sku_type_complete

keywords = TRIM(sku_type_complete + ' ' + keyword_typo), verified 548/549. keyword_typo holds model aliases, e.g. 'CWD 7601' on the Cosmos CWD7601 row -> keywords 'Cosmos CWD7601 Bottom Loading CWD 7601'.
keyword_typo: '' on 504/549, never NULL. product_price: '' on 335/549, otherwise a thousands-separated string like '1,289,000.00'. Use '' for both on a new row.
sku_type_complete = type + ' ' + category (548/549; the single exception, sku_type_complete
'DEP-858VT' on the Denpoo DDB 39 row, is a data error -- do not imitate it).
keywords = sku_type_complete, optionally followed by extra alias/typo tokens separated by a
single space (503/549 are exactly equal; the rest append model aliases, e.g. 'Denpoo DDB-920
Bottom Loading DDB-920 DDB 920').
keyword_typo: '' on 504/549, never NULL. product_price: '' on 335/549, otherwise a
thousands-separated string like '1,289,000.00'. Use '' for both on a new row.
category vocabulary (use an existing value, never invent): 'Bottom Loading' 247, 'Top Loading'
130, 'Water Dispenser' 79, 'Table Top' 75, 'Top Bottom Load' 17, 'Portable' 1. 'Water
Dispenser' is the catch-all used for non-gallon-cabinet forms -- gallon pumps, termos/drink-jar
dispensers, water boilers. The unbranded catch-all row is 'No Brand Water Dispenser Water
Dispenser' (brand 'No Brand'), which carries 312 QA rows.
